topics.name: Thin orchestration boundaries
topics.summary: Thin orchestration boundaries keep central agents focused on routing and typed handoffs while specialists retain narrow context and tools.
topics.why_now: This topic is carried pending evidence from another organization that measures route accuracy, revision rates and specialist-boundary failures.
topics.practical_value: Agent teams can compare one broad agent with deterministic routing, typed handoffs and explicit revision measurements on representative work.

durability.reason: Separation of coordination and execution should persist, although optimal specialist granularity will vary by workflow.

momentum.reason: A single internal case study cannot establish numerical momentum over time.

topics.name: Multimodal evidence retrieval for agents

topics.why_now: The topic is carried while teams still need independent evaluation of retrieval relevance, task success, token use and throughput.
topics.practical_value: Teams can benchmark each stage separately on their own documents, measuring relevance, downstream task success, token use and serving throughput.

topics.name: Desktop-scale frontier model clusters
topics.summary: Desktop-scale model clusters join compact AI workstations so their combined memory and interconnect can serve models that exceed one node.
topics.why_now: NVIDIA published an eight-node configuration, full-model run and topology measurements on October 22, creating a concrete baseline for evaluation.
topics.practical_value: Infrastructure teams can reproduce a bounded cluster test and compare throughput, synchronization cost, network load, memory headroom and failures.

evidence.title: Desktop-scale frontier model clusters

topics.limitations: The preserved evidence supports monitoring, not a claim of broad adoption or independent validation.

novelty.reason: The article demonstrates a coordinated eight-node desktop cluster serving a frontier-scale model without datacenter-class chassis.

evidence.reason: NVIDIA publishes topology, memory, model, throughput and scaling details, although the complete evaluation remains vendor-operated.

independence.reason: The configuration is reproducible in principle, but no independently operated eight-node comparison was reviewed for this release.

momentum.reason: One dated benchmark supplies no comparable second observation under a stable deployment or adoption measure.

relevance.reason: Small infrastructure teams can reproduce a bounded topology trial and measure throughput, overhead, memory pressure and resilience.

durability.reason: Topology-aware distributed inference remains useful even as workstation hardware, interconnects and frontier model sizes change.

momentum.reason: One dated benchmark supplies no comparable second observation under a stable deployment or adoption measure.
